title: Piloting UAP/orbs by moving consciousness into them in the lab

tellings.quote: So, for example, let's say there was an orb or something and I was asked to fly it.

plain: A man who goes only by Jordan says a secret UFO program took him as a child, around 2008 to 2010, at a place in New York called Baker Victory Services. He says that in a lab there he was asked to fly glowing orbs and other unexplained objects by moving his mind into them. If true, it would mean these craft are steered by thought, not by controls.
